SELECT round(avg(paid_amount), 2) AS avg_paid
               FROM sem.remit_claims
               WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount > 0
                 AND payer_name = 'Medicare Part B North Carolina'

WITH first_sub AS (
                 SELECT claim_key, submission_date AS first_sub, service_date_from AS dos
                 FROM (
                   SELECT claim_key, submission_date, service_date_from,
                          row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date, claim_id) AS rn
                   FROM sem.claims
                 ) s WHERE rn = 1
               ),
               prim AS (
                 SELECT claim_key, payer_class FROM (
                   SELECT claim_key, payer_class,
                          row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC) AS rn
                   FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
                 ) p WHERE rn = 1
               ),
               lags AS (
                 SELECT p.payer_class, date_diff('day', f.dos, f.first_sub) AS lag_days
                 FROM first_sub f JOIN prim p USING (claim_key)
                 WHERE f.dos IS NOT NULL AND f.first_sub IS NOT NULL
               )
               SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS claims, round(avg(lag_days), 2) AS avg_lag_days,
                      median(lag_days) AS median_lag_days,
                      count(*) FILTER (WHERE lag_days > 90) AS claims_over_90
               FROM lags GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT submission_month, count(*) AS corrected_claims, round(sum(charge_amount), 2) AS billed
               FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7'
               GROUP BY submission_month ORDER BY submission_month

WITH prim AS (
                 SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) AS payer_class, min(submission_date) AS first_sub
                 FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
                 GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key
               ),
               paid AS (
                 SELECT p.payer_class, date_diff('day', p.first_sub, r.payment_date) AS days
                 FROM prim p
                 JOIN sem.remit_claims r
                   ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key
                 WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0
                   AND p.first_sub IS NOT NULL AND r.payment_date IS NOT NULL
               )
               SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS paid_claims,
                      round(median(days), 1) AS median_days,
                      round(quantile_cont(days, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days
               FROM paid GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT a.carc_code, count(DISTINCT r.claim_payer_key) AS denied_claims
               FROM sem.adjustments a
               JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.remit_claim_id = a.remit_claim_id
               WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied
                 AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
               GROUP BY a.carc_code
               ORDER BY denied_claims DESC, a.carc_code
               LIMIT 5

WITH pairs AS (
                 SELECT any_value(payer_class) AS payer_class, claim_payer_key,
                        count(*) AS events,
                        bool_or(is_current_adjudication AND NOT is_denied AND NOT is_reversal) AS good_current
                 FROM sem.remit_claims
                 GROUP BY claim_payer_key
               )
               SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS remitted_pairs,
                      count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 1 AND good_current) AS first_pass,
                      round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE events = 1 AND good_current) / count(*), 2) AS rate_pct
               FROM pairs GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT a.carc_code,
                      count(DISTINCT r.claim_payer_key) AS pairs,
                      round(sum(a.adjustment_amount), 2) AS co_amount
               FROM sem.remit_claims r
               JOIN sem.adjustments a ON a.remit_claim_id = r.remit_claim_id
               WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND r.is_denied
                 AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc
               GROUP BY a.carc_code
               ORDER BY pairs DESC, a.carc_code

WITH base AS (
                 SELECT DISTINCT l.procedure_code, c.claim_key, c.principal_diagnosis_code AS dx
                 FROM sem.claim_lines l
                 JOIN sem.claims c ON c.claim_id = l.claim_id
                 WHERE c.is_latest_submission AND l.procedure_code IS NOT NULL
               ),
               counts AS (
                 SELECT procedure_code, dx, count(*) AS n
                 FROM base WHERE dx IS NOT NULL
                 GROUP BY procedure_code, dx
               ),
               totals AS (
                 SELECT procedure_code, count(*) AS total FROM base GROUP BY procedure_code
               ),
               ranked AS (
                 SELECT procedure_code, dx, n,
                        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY procedure_code ORDER BY n DESC, dx ASC) AS rn
                 FROM counts
               )
               SELECT r.procedure_code, r.dx, r.n, t.total,
                      round(100.0 * r.n / t.total, 1) AS share_pct
               FROM ranked r JOIN totals t USING (procedure_code)
               WHERE r.rn = 1
               ORDER BY r.procedure_code

SELECT round(avg(is_denied::INT), 4) AS denial_rate
               FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication

WITH ev AS (
                 SELECT any_value(payer_class) AS payer_class, claim_payer_key,
                        count(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS traces,
                        bool_or(is_reversal) AS has_reversal,
                        bool_or(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current,
                        coalesce(sum(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication), 0) AS paid
                 FROM sem.remit_claims
                 GROUP BY claim_payer_key
               )
               SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS multi_trace_pairs,
                      count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_reversal) AS with_reversal,
                      count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current) AS no_current,
                      round(sum(paid), 2) AS paid
               FROM ev WHERE traces >= 2
               GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

WITH c AS (
                 SELECT line_count, count(*) AS claims, sum(charge_amount) AS billed
                 FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission
                 GROUP BY line_count
               ),
               t AS (SELECT sum(claims) AS n FROM c)
               SELECT c.line_count, c.claims,
                      round(100.0 * c.claims / t.n, 1) AS share_pct,
                      round(c.billed / c.claims, 2) AS avg_billed
               FROM c, t ORDER BY c.line_count

SELECT count(*) AS partial_denied_lines
               FROM sem.remit_lines
               WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

SELECT coalesce(round(sum(a.adjustment_amount), 2), 0) AS deductible
               FROM sem.adjustments a
               JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.remit_claim_id = a.remit_claim_id
               WHERE r.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1'
                 AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM sem.claims c
                   WHERE c.claim_key = r.claim_key AND c.payer_key = r.payer_key
                     AND c.payer_responsibility = 'P')

SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS adjudications,
                      round(sum(charge_amount), 2) AS billed,
                      round(sum(paid_amount), 2) AS paid,
                      round(sum(coalesce(patient_responsibility_amount, 0)), 2) AS patient_responsibility,
                      round(100.0 * sum(paid_amount) / nullif(sum(charge_amount), 0), 1) AS paid_pct,
                      round(100.0 * sum(coalesce(patient_responsibility_amount, 0)) / nullif(sum(charge_amount), 0), 1) AS pr_pct
               FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication
               GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

SELECT count(DISTINCT claim_key) AS voided_claims
               FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '8'

SELECT count(*) AS denied_lines
               FROM sem.remit_lines
               WHERE is_current_adjudication AND line_is_denied AND procedure_code = '36415'

WITH c AS (
                 SELECT service_month, claim_key, referring_npi
                 FROM sem.claims
                 WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01'
               ),
               by_npi AS (
                 SELECT service_month, referring_npi, count(*) AS n
                 FROM c WHERE referring_npi IS NOT NULL
                 GROUP BY service_month, referring_npi
               ),
               ranked AS (
                 SELECT service_month, n,
                        row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY n DESC, referring_npi ASC) AS rn
                 FROM by_npi
               ),
               top AS (
                 SELECT service_month, sum(n) AS top5 FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY service_month
               ),
               tot AS (
                 SELECT service_month, count(*) AS total FROM c GROUP BY service_month
               )
               SELECT t.service_month, t.total, coalesce(top.top5, 0) AS top5_claims,
                      round(100.0 * coalesce(top.top5, 0) / t.total, 1) AS share_pct
               FROM tot t LEFT JOIN top USING (service_month)
               ORDER BY t.service_month

WITH primary_sub AS (
                 SELECT claim_key, payer_class, charge_amount FROM (
                   SELECT claim_key, payer_class, charge_amount,
                          row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC) AS rn
                   FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P'
                 ) s WHERE rn = 1
               ),
               g AS (
                 SELECT payer_class, count(*) AS claims, sum(charge_amount) AS billed
                 FROM primary_sub GROUP BY payer_class
               ),
               t AS (SELECT sum(claims) AS n, sum(billed) AS b FROM g)
               SELECT g.payer_class, g.claims,
                      round(100.0 * g.claims / t.n, 1) AS claims_pct,
                      round(g.billed, 2) AS billed,
                      round(100.0 * g.billed / nullif(t.b, 0), 1) AS billed_pct
               FROM g, t ORDER BY g.payer_class

SELECT round(sum(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '87798')
                            / nullif(sum(line_paid_amount), 0), 4) AS share
               FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication

SELECT round(sum(paid_amount), 2) AS total_paid
               FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication

notes: Dataset is the frozen generator 3.3 snapshot at .ccsim/bench/f22d94791686 built with Scenario(days=15, volume_scale=0.2, seed=3), the smallest snapshot() config used by the agent tests, opened with open_snapshot(escalate=False). Dev ids are the first 20 benchmark questions by sha256(question_id) after dropping question_set heldout_hard_1 and any grokbot-r1 tag. Planner wrote a metric spec per question; the SQL writer saw only that spec, the sem column dictionary, the basic glossary, and a 24-query explore profile (distinct values, ranges, null rates, join cardinalities). No few-shot SQL. Three candidates executed once each; agreement pick; no repair. The 24 explore queries are allocated across the 20 results (16 questions +1, four questions +2) so mean_sql_execs counts each probe once.
